body: Not all economy seats are created equal. A comparison of maximum reported standard economy seat pitch on selected long-haul aircraft from 20 major international airlines puts Japan Airlines and All Nippon Airways (ANA) at the top, with 34 inches (86 cm) on selected aircraft. The comparison covers main-cabin economy seats only, excluding extra-legroom seats that often cost extra, and the figures are maximums for selected aircraft rather than fleet-wide averages.

Air New Zealand and Etihad Airways follow at 33 inches, while Cathay Pacific, Singapore Airlines, Emirates, Qatar Airways, Qantas, Air Canada and Delta Air Lines sit at 32 inches on their roomiest long-haul configurations. A further group at 31 inches includes American Airlines, United Airlines, British Airways, Virgin Atlantic, Air France, KLM, Lufthansa, Turkish Airlines and Aer Lingus. Japan Airlines' SKY WIDER seats appear on selected Boeing 787, 777 and 767 aircraft, and ANA's 34-inch figure applies to its 206-seat Boeing 787-9 configuration, where slimline seats are designed to improve knee clearance without taking up more cabin space.

Seat pitch itself only measures the distance between a fixed point on one seat and the same point on the seat directly ahead or behind it, so it does not by itself measure usable knee clearance. Seat design, cushion thickness, recline and the position of the seatback pocket can all change how a seat feels, and two seats with identical pitch may feel different. Because airlines operate several configurations of the same aircraft type and can swap aircraft at short notice, the comparison's advice is to check the seat map for the aircraft actually assigned to a flight before booking.
en.summary: Japan Airlines and ANA offer the most economy legroom in a comparison of 20 major airlines, at 34 inches of seat pitch on selected long-haul aircraft, but the figures are maximums for specific configurations, not fleet-wide averages.
en.title: Which airlines offer the most legroom in economy class?

body: 並非所有經濟艙座位都一樣寬敞。一份比較20家主要國際航空公司部分長程機型最大標準經濟艙椅距的整理指出，日本航空與全日空並列第一，在部分機型上達到34吋（86公分）。這份比較只計算標準經濟艙，不含通常要加價的加大腿部空間座位，而且數字是特定機型的最大值，不是整個機隊的平均值。

紐西蘭航空與阿提哈德航空以33吋居次，國泰航空、新加坡航空、阿聯酋航空、卡達航空、澳洲航空、加拿大航空與達美航空在最寬敞的長程配置上為32吋，另有美國航空、聯合航空、英國航空、維珍航空、法國航空、荷蘭皇家航空、漢莎航空、土耳其航空與愛爾蘭航空同為31吋。日本航空的SKY WIDER座位裝設於部分波音787、777與767機型，全日空的34吋則見於206席的波音787-9配置，其薄型座椅設計可在不增加座艙空間的情況下改善膝部空間。
椅距本身只量測同一座位固定點與前後座位對應點之間的距離，並不等於實際可用的膝部空間，座椅設計、椅墊厚度、椅背傾斜角度與椅背置物袋位置都會影響乘坐感受。由於同一機型常有多種座艙配置，航空公司也可能臨時更換執飛機型，比較結果建議旅客訂位前先確認實際執飛機型的座位圖。
zh.summary: 日本航空與全日空在20家主要航空公司的經濟艙椅距比較中並列第一，部分長程機型達34吋，但數字是特定配置的最大值，而非機隊平均。
